title: nf-core/gwasqc pipeline parameters
description: A pipeline for genotype array quality control

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Path to the comma-separated samplesheet declaring one PLINK 1 fileset per stratum.
input.help_text: You will need to create a samplesheet with one row per stratum before running the pipeline. Use this parameter to specify its location. It has to be a comma-separated file with the 5 columns `id,ancestry,bed,bim,fam` and a header row. See [usage docs](https://nf-co.re/gwasqc/usage#samplesheet-input).

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.

email.help_text: Set this parameter to your e-mail address to get a summary e-mail with details of the run sent to you when the workflow exits. If set in your user config file (`~/.nextflow/config`) then you don't need to specify this on the command line for every run.

multiqc_title.description: MultiQC report title. Printed as page header, used for filename if not otherwise specified.

reference_options.title: Reference options
reference_options.description: Genome build and reference assets the QC chain relies on.

genome_build.description: Genome build of the study filesets, passed to plink2 `--split-par`, which moves the chromosome X pseudo-autosomal regions to their own codes before the sex check; the reference panel must be on the same build.
genome_build.help_text: The pseudo-autosomal boundaries differ between builds, and the default long-range LD asset is GRCh38; a different build needs a matching `--high_ld_regions` file. The ancestry route matches study and reference variants by chromosome, position and alleles, and stops, naming this parameter, when most of the variants whose ID both sides carry sit at different positions, the signature of a reference panel on another build. Lift the panel over to the study's build before the run; see the usage documentation on preparing the reference panel.

high_ld_regions.description: BED file of long-range linkage-disequilibrium regions whose pruned variants are excluded, together with every non-autosomal variant, from the heterozygosity and relatedness reports and from the reference panel before its pruning.
high_ld_regions.help_text: Zero-based, half-open intervals with bare chromosome codes (1-22). The default asset is derived from the legacy `highLDregions4bim_b38.awk` rules; see the file header for the derivation.

reference_panel.description: Path to the samplesheet declaring the PLINK 1 filesets of the ancestry reference panel, one row per fileset; required unless `--skip_ancestry` is set.
reference_panel.help_text: A comma- or tab-separated file with the columns `id,bed,bim,fam` and a header row. A whole-genome panel is one row; the legacy per-chromosome 1000 Genomes layout is one row per chromosome. Every fileset is restricted to the variants it shares with each stratum, matched by position and alleles, and the restrictions are merged, so the rows must share their samples and carry disjoint variants; the panel must be on the build of `--genome_build` and carry unique variant IDs. See [usage docs](https://nf-co.re/gwasqc/usage#reference-panel).

reference_pop_data.description: Path to the tab-separated table labelling every reference sample with the columns `FID`, `IID`, `pop` and `super_pop`; required unless `--skip_ancestry` is set.
reference_pop_data.help_text: The `super_pop` labels are the groups the ancestry classifier learns and the vocabulary a samplesheet `ancestry` label is matched against; every sample of the reference panel must be labelled.

qc_threshold_options.title: QC threshold options
qc_threshold_options.description: Thresholds and order of the variant filter chain. Every comparison is strict, as in plink2 itself.

maf.description: Minor allele frequency threshold; variants with a frequency below this value are dropped before any other statistic is computed.

geno.description: Maximum per-variant missing-call rate; variants whose rate exceeds this value are listed for exclusion.
geno.help_text: Under `--missingness_mode iterative` (the default) this is the last rung of the call-rate ladder: it must equal `--mind` and be a whole percentage from 0.01 to 0.10, and the ladder is applied from 0.10 down to it.

mind.description: Maximum per-sample missing-call rate; samples whose rate exceeds this value are listed for removal.
mind.help_text: Under `--missingness_mode iterative` (the default) it must equal `--geno`.

hwe.description: Hardy-Weinberg equilibrium exact-test p-value threshold; variants with a p-value below this value are listed for exclusion.

missingness_mode.description: How the variant and sample missingness thresholds are applied: `iterative` applies the call-rate ladder from 90 % up to the call rate 1 - `--geno`, each rung's variant and then sample threshold on the previous rung's result, as the legacy GLAD pipeline applied it; `single` applies `--geno` and then `--mind` once.
missingness_mode.help_text: `iterative` needs `--geno` and `--mind` to be equal and a whole percentage from 0.01 to 0.10: the legacy ladder steps whole call-rate percentages and applies one threshold to variants and samples at each rung. `single` takes any pair of thresholds. The call-rate ladder table is computed and published in both modes.

ld_pruning_options.title: LD pruning options
ld_pruning_options.description: Parameters of the plink2 `--indep-pairwise` run that selects the variant set of the sex check, heterozygosity and relatedness reports of a stratum in the `study` marker-set mode, and the pruning-collapse warning.

ld_step_size.description: Number of variants the pruning window shifts at each step.

ld_r2.description: Pairwise r-squared above which one variant of a pair is pruned.

ld_min_retained_fraction.description: Fraction of the QC'd variants below which `study`-mode LD pruning is reported as collapsed: the stratum's summary row and the MultiQC marker-set section then carry a note recommending the `shared` marker set.
ld_min_retained_fraction.help_text: Pairwise r-squared over a few dozen samples has an inflated upper tail, so `--indep-pairwise` on a small stratum can discard nearly every variant; an 11-sample stratum of the legacy cohort kept 0.5 %. The note is informational and nothing is re-decided.

sample_qc_options.title: Sample QC options
sample_qc_options.description: The marker set of the sample checks, the thresholds of the sex check and relatedness decisions, and whether their removal lists are applied to the QC'd fileset.

sample_qc_marker_set.description: Which variant set the sex check, heterozygosity and relatedness reports of each stratum run on: `study`, the stratum's own LD-pruned QC'd variants; `shared`, the harmonised, reference-pruned autosomal markers of the ancestry route, with ancestry-matched reference allele frequencies as the heterozygosity baseline; or `auto`, which chooses `shared` for a stratum with fewer than `--small_n_threshold` samples after the mind filter and `study` otherwise.
sample_qc_marker_set.help_text: In `shared` mode no study-side `--indep-pairwise` runs: the heterozygosity report is computed on the study and on the ancestry-matched reference samples over the shared markers with `--read-freq` of the matched reference frequencies, KING relatedness runs on the shared markers, and the sex check runs on every QC-passing chromosome X and Y variant without pruning, because the reference carries no chromosome X. `shared` needs `--reference_panel` and `--reference_pop_data`; with `--skip_ancestry` it is an error, as is a stratum that `auto` would send to `shared`. The mode chosen for each stratum is recorded in `gwasqc_summary.tsv` and the MultiQC report.

sample_qc_shared_reference.description: Which reference samples choose the `shared` marker set: `matched`, the reference samples of the stratum's super-population, on which the ancestry-stage `--ancestry_maf`, `--ancestry_geno` and `--ancestry_hwe` filters, the long-range LD exclusion and `--indep-pairwise` are applied; or `pooled`, every reference sample, so that the shared markers are the ancestry decomposition's own filtered, pruned list.
sample_qc_shared_reference.help_text: Only strata in the `shared` mode read this. Under `matched` the filters and pruning run on the reference samples whose `super_pop` in `--reference_pop_data` is the stratum's `ancestry`, over the merged, harmonised reference; plink2 refuses to prune fewer than 50 samples, so a stratum whose super-population has fewer than 50 reference samples uses the pooled panel instead, and its summary row records `pooled` with a note. The ancestry decomposition and projection use the pooled panel either way, and the heterozygosity baseline is the matched samples either way. The choice and the marker count of each stratum are recorded in `gwasqc_summary.tsv` and the MultiQC report.

small_n_threshold.description: Under `--sample_qc_marker_set auto`, a stratum with fewer than this many samples after the mind filter uses the `shared` marker set; every other stratum uses `study`.
small_n_threshold.help_text: The per-stratum sample count after the mind filter is the input `.fam` line count minus the lines of the mind removal list; the comparison is strict (fewer than).

sex_check_max_female_xf.description: Chromosome X inbreeding coefficient F below which plink2 `--check-sex` calls a sample female.

sex_check_min_male_xf.description: Chromosome X inbreeding coefficient F above which plink2 `--check-sex` calls a sample male.

sex_check_max_female_ycount.description: Largest number of non-missing chromosome Y calls a sample called female may carry; more downgrades the call to a mismatch.

sex_check_min_male_ycount.description: Smallest number of non-missing chromosome Y calls a sample called male must carry; fewer downgrades the call to a mismatch.
sex_check_min_male_ycount.help_text: plink1.9 `--check-sex ycount` defaulted this to 0, which plink2 rejects; 1 is the smallest value plink2 accepts and the plink1.9 `y-only` default.

king_table_filter.description: Minimum KING-robust kinship coefficient a sample pair needs to be written to the relatedness table; the default is the third-degree lower bound.
king_table_filter.help_text: Pairs below the filter are absent from the table and count as unrelated in the per-individual mean kinship. Lowering it enlarges the table quadratically in the sample count.

relatedness_indiv_sd.description: Number of standard deviations above the cohort mean kinship at which an individual is listed as a mean-kinship outlier.

relatedness_po_ibs0_max.description: Largest IBS0 proportion at which a first-degree pair is classified parent-offspring rather than full sibling.
relatedness_po_ibs0_max.help_text: A parent-offspring pair shares one allele at every locus, so its IBS0 is bounded by the genotyping error rate; full sibs are IBD0 over a quarter of the genome and show IBS0 well above it.

apply_sample_removals.description: Apply the sex-mismatch, duplicate/MZ relatedness and, unless `--ancestry_remove_mismatched` is off, ancestry mismatch removal lists, which the legacy chain only reported, when writing the QC'd fileset; the missingness removals are always applied.
apply_sample_removals.help_text: The lists are published either way. The mean-kinship outlier list is published but never applied.

ancestry_options.title: Ancestry options
ancestry_options.description: Inference of every sample's super-population against the reference panel: pruning and decomposition of the harmonised reference, projection of both sample sets, and the assignment rule.

skip_ancestry.description: Skip the ancestry inference; `--reference_panel` and `--reference_pop_data` are then not needed.

ancestry_ld_window_size.description: Window size of `--indep-pairwise` on the merged reference, in variants.

ancestry_ld_step_size.description: Number of variants the reference pruning window shifts at each step.

ancestry_ld_r2.description: Pairwise r-squared above which one variant of a reference pair is pruned.

ancestry_n_pcs.description: Number of reference principal components computed with `--pca allele-wts` and projected onto both sample sets; the classifier uses all of them and the plots the first four.
ancestry_n_pcs.help_text: plink2 refuses `--pca` on fewer than 50 reference samples, and recommends its `approx` modifier, available through `ext.args` of `PLINK2_PCAWTS`, on panels far beyond 5000 samples.

ancestry_geno.description: Maximum per-variant missing-call rate of the ancestry stage, applied to the study's QC'd variants before they are matched to the reference and to the reference samples before pruning.

ancestry_maf.description: Minor allele frequency threshold of the ancestry stage, applied with `--ancestry_geno`; defaults to `--maf`.
ancestry_maf.help_text: The study-side filter applies it only to a stratum of more than 100 samples after the mind filter, as the legacy ancestry script did; a smaller stratum is filtered on `--ancestry_geno` alone.

ancestry_hwe.description: Hardy-Weinberg exact-test p-value threshold of the ancestry stage, applied with `--ancestry_geno`.
ancestry_hwe.help_text: The study-side filter applies it only to a stratum of more than 100 samples after the mind filter; on the reference it is tested over the reference samples the markers are pruned on, the pooled panel or, for the shared marker set under `matched`, the stratum's super-population.

ancestry_prob_threshold.description: Class probability at or above which a study sample is assigned to its most probable super-population; below it the sample is unassigned.

ancestry_sd_filter.description: When set, an assigned study sample whose coordinate on any component lies more than this many standard deviations from its super-population's reference mean becomes unassigned; off by default.
ancestry_sd_filter.help_text: The legacy script reported this rule at 3 standard deviations while leaving it commented out. Here the summary states which rule produced every count.

ancestry_remove_mismatched.description: Under `--apply_sample_removals`, also remove the study samples not assigned to their stratum's `ancestry` label, the unassigned included; the list is published either way.
ancestry_remove_mismatched.help_text: With this on, every stratum's `ancestry` label must be one of the `super_pop` labels of `--reference_pop_data`, or the run stops before anything is computed.

institutional_config_options.title: Institutional config options
institutional_config_options.description: Parameters used to describe centralised config profiles. These should not be edited.
institutional_config_options.help_text: The centralised nf-core configuration profiles use a handful of pipeline parameters to describe themselves. This information is then printed to the Nextflow log when you run a pipeline. You should not need to change these values when you run a pipeline.

custom_config_version.description: Git commit id for Institutional configs.

custom_config_base.help_text: If you're running offline, Nextflow will not be able to fetch the institutional config files from the internet. If you don't need them, then this is not a problem. If you do need them, you should download the files from the repo and tell Nextflow where to find them with this parameter.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.
generic_options.help_text:
These options are common to all nf-core pipelines and allow you to customise some of the core preferences for how the pipeline runs.

Typically these options would be set in a Nextflow config file loaded for all pipeline runs, such as `~/.nextflow/config`.

publish_dir_mode.description: Method used to save pipeline results to output directory.
publish_dir_mode.help_text: The Nextflow `publishDir` option specifies which intermediate files should be saved to the output directory. This option tells the pipeline what method should be used to move these files. See [Nextflow docs](https://www.nextflow.io/docs/latest/process.html#publishdir) for details.

email_on_fail.description: Email address for completion summary, only when pipeline fails.
email_on_fail.help_text: An email address to send a summary email to when the pipeline is completed - ONLY sent if the pipeline does not exit successfully.

plaintext_email.description: Send plain-text email instead of HTML.

max_multiqc_email_size.description: File size limit when attaching MultiQC reports to summary emails.

monochrome_logs.description: Do not use coloured log outputs.

multiqc_config.description: Custom config file to supply to MultiQC.

multiqc_logo.description: Custom logo file to supply to MultiQC. File name must also be set in the MultiQC config file

multiqc_methods_description.description: Custom MultiQC yaml file containing HTML including a methods description.

validate_params.description: Boolean whether to validate parameters against the schema at runtime

pipelines_testdata_base_path.description: Base URL or local path to location of pipeline test dataset files.

trace_report_suffix.description: Suffix to add to the trace report filename. Default is the date and time in the format yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss.

help_full.description: Display the full detailed help message.

show_hidden.description: Display hidden parameters in the help message (only works when --help or --help_full are provided).
